hpp.artifacts.leatherArmorOfSwiftness.de:
{Leather Armor of Swiftness}

A fused relic shaped from {Necklace of Swiftness}, {Ring of the Wayfarer}, and {Cape of Velocity}.

The bearer's army gains {+2} Speed.

All heroes on the bearer's {team} gain {+1} Speed for their armies, including the bearer.

The components are {consumed} during assembly and cannot be recovered.
hpp.artifacts.leatherArmorOfSwiftness.ev: The necklace, ring, and cape bind themselves into a light leather armor traced with pale gold. It moves as if carried by the wind, urging every allied army to answer with impossible speed.
